introTitle: Comrade, Accelerate Your Five-Year Plan Without Tanking FPS!
introBody:
Tired of waiting 20 minutes in Fast Forward (>>) while your starter town builds—or watching your frame rate crater in a late-game republic because vanilla >> pushes too hard?

By decree of the [b]Supreme Soviet Temporal Efficiency Directorate[/b], [b]AdaptiveSimSpeed[/b] measures simulation cost and adaptively scales Fast Forward (up to [b]15x[/b]) inside your unused frame headroom—delivering rapid early-game construction and gracefully throttling down to protect your target FPS in massive cities.

[b]⚠️ EARLY ALPHA DISCLAIMER — NEEDS MORE TESTING:[/b] It hooks into and manipulates many small internal engine and simulation timings whose full side effects across the entire game are not completely known yet — especially in [b]large production chains[/b], dense rail/signal networks, and huge late-game republics. In theory, everything [i]should[/i] work cleanly because it scales simulation progression within your frame budget rather than breaking 1x step behavior, [b]but unexpected side effects may still occur[/b].
operatingSection:
[h1]Operating Adaptive Sim Speed (In-Game)[/h1][list]
[*] Press [b]F9[/b] anytime in-game to open [b]WRSR Tweaks [F9][/b] -> [b]Sim Speed[/b] tab (or [b]Esc[/b] to close).
[*] [b]Enable Adaptive Fast-Forward:[/b] Master toggle for adaptive simulation speed scaling.
[*] [b]Only Boost >> (Fast-Forward):[/b] Keeps 1x Play completely vanilla for building and watching.
[*] [b]Max Fast-Forward Speed (3x - 15x):[/b] Upper bound on simulation speed when FPS headroom is available.
[*] [b]Target Min FPS (30 - 120) & Render Reserve (ms):[/b] Protects frame rate and DX11/OS headroom.
[*] [b]Save Config (Ctrl+S):[/b] Writes settings to [i]AdaptiveSimSpeed.ini[/i] beside the plugin DLL.
[/list]
examplesSection:
[h1]Recommended Modes[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Vanilla 3x / Balanced 6x / Turbo 10x / Uncapped 15x:[/b] One-click quick presets right inside the F9 tab.
[*] [b]Smooth Late-Game Cities:[/b] Keep [i]Target Min FPS = 60[/i] and [i]Render Headroom Reserve = 4.0 ms[/i] so fast-forward automatically scales down before stuttering.
[/list]
guaranteesSection:
[h1]Five-Year Plan Guarantees (Save-Safe & Lightweight)[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Headroom-Aware Scaling:[/b] Uses high-resolution QPC timing (EMA-smoothed) to stay within your frame budget.
[*] [b]100% Save-Safe:[/b] Zero save format changes; settings live cleanly in [i]AdaptiveSimSpeed.ini[/i] next to the DLL.
[/list]
